status: pre-registered before the grader ran on any demo PR (#6645, #6641, #6658). reason.thresholds.load_thresholds is the only reader in the product path; the eval kit reads the same file. A change after the first run must be logged in docs/DECISIONS.md with the reason.

_doc.retrieval.max_hops: reverse (importer/renderer) hop cap; must equal models.MAX_HOPS (D25, case 50)
_doc.retrieval.forward_hops: forward hops admitted by the EXPAND action only (D25)
_doc.retrieval.max_seeds: changed source files analysed individually; the rest are counted and listed as not assessed (case 45 is DEFER)
_doc.retrieval.tier2_cap: indirect items shown (REPORT_SPEC section 4); the uncapped list stays in impact.json (case 61)
_doc.retrieval.undetermined_top: aggregated could-not-determine rows shown in the report; the rest is in needs_review.json (case 61)
_doc.grade.breadth_fraction_h2: plan section 7: a seed whose 2-hop closure holds >= this share of all UI files is too broad to accept (measured: the two #6645 services reach 26.8% and 27.7%)
_doc.grade.hub_fraction_h1: a seed with direct UI importers >= this share of all UI files is a hub on its own
_doc.grade.min_element_confidence: CORRECT needs at least one reached element at or above this confidence (the 'likely' floor of models.band_for)
_doc.grade.max_rounds: corrective rounds per seed (plan section 7); ESCALATE only records and does not use a round
_doc.caps: the verdict, the change kind and the action CAP a route's confidence; nothing in reason raises one (D17, plan section 7)
_doc.caps.ambiguous_indirect: indirect routes of a seed that stays AMBIGUOUS: 'possible' at most
_doc.caps.additive_reader: case 76: readers of an additive-only change keep their edge as 'possible'; downgraded, never deleted
_doc.caps.symbol_miss: importer names none of the changed symbols (symbols known): lowest 'possible'
_doc.caps.type_only: type-only or comment-only change: no runtime behaviour change, any route
_doc.caps.forward: routes admitted by the forward hop of EXPAND
_doc.caps.locale_route: routes admitted through shared i18n keys by EXPAND
_doc.caps.copy_other_element: element that shares a file with a changed key but whose own text is not the changed string
_doc.caps.unmapped_probe: routes found by an explicit probe, no stronger evidence than 'possible'
_doc.confidence.stored_data: a changed data-schema file is a certain change of the saved format
_doc.confidence.global: a changed layout or global style reaches every screen by construction
_doc.judge: D18: <= max_candidates evidenced candidates per AMBIGUOUS subgraph, <= max_calls per PR, two samples per subgraph (disagreement goes to needs_review)
_doc.judge.reserve: forward routes the grader held back that the judge may nominate from
_doc.judge.max_nominations: labels the judge may nominate per sample; admitted only when both samples agree
